kpis.signal: BPA dilue T (10-Q/10-K Consolidated Statements of Operations, us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted)
Total revenues T (10-Q Consolidated Statements of Operations, us-gaap:Revenues)
Net income T (10-Q Consolidated Statements of Operations, us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss)
Operating income T (us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss). Historique partiel: XBRL rapportait cette ligne de facon intermittente avant 2025.
Cash from operations T (us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities, YTD cumule dans 10-Q derive trimestriel).
Capex = us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRealEstate + PaymentsToDevelopRealEstateAssets (10-Q Cash Flow YTD derive trimestriel). Volatile: acquisitions ponctuelles.
FCF _derived = OCF trimestriel - Capex immobiliers trimestriels (acquisitions+developpement). Aucune ligne FCF publiee par PSA (REIT).
Dividend declared per common share T (us-gaap:CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared, 10-Q/10-K equity statement). Q3-2022=13.15$: dividende special exceptionnel de 13.15$ + reguliers.
Notes payable / long-term debt balance sheet (us-gaap:LongTermDebt). Historique disponible depuis Q1-2016 dans XBRL.
Interest expense T (us-gaap:InterestExpense, 10-Q Consolidated Statements of Operations).
Total public storage shareholders equity (us-gaap:StockholdersEquity, 10-Q Balance Sheet).
Total assets (us-gaap:Assets, 10-Q Balance Sheet).
Cash and cash equivalents (us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue).
Nombre total de self-storage facilities detenus (10-Q/10-K, phrase d'introduction "X,XXX self-storage facilities"). Metrique cle secteur REIT self-storage.
FFO (Funds from Operations) per diluted common share, non-GAAP Nareit definition (10-Q/10-K MD&A "FFO was $X.XX per diluted common share"). Metrique cle REIT.
Nombre d'employes (10-K Item 1 "approximately X employees"). Annuel uniquement (non divulgue en 10-Q).
Real estate investment property net (us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentPropertyNet, 10-Q Balance Sheet).
Marge nette _derived = Net income T / Revenues T (source XBRL us-gaap).
Levier _derived = LongTermDebt / StockholdersEquity (XBRL us-gaap).
